description: The main window may call exactly six app commands: ipc_boundary_status, which only proves the IPC boundary; get_runtime_status, a fixed read-only runtime identity query that is unavailable unless the development-only dev-runtime feature is built; and list_projects, add_project, remove_project and reset_projects, which manage the local project registry, take no path and open the folder panel only from Rust. It is granted no shell, filesystem, dialog, network, opener or core plugin permission.
